bootstrap_requirements.statement: Verified preservation refs, recoverable unique work and restore-tested bundle precede source replacement.
Build and deployment consumers remain pinned to the preserved implementation until authorized cutover.
Fresh checkout has real entrypoints, dependencies and isolated check routes; unsupported features return explicit errors.
Real identity and writer capabilities enforce ownership; deliberate forbidden dependency and write attempts fail.
New stores have verified routing and prefixes; historical tasks are reconciled without closing old operational obligations.
Packaged clients expose independently expected fixture facts, bad-input outcomes and crash/restart recovery in a reproducible report.

tasks.title: Preserve the predecessor and its deployment consumers
tasks.scope: Preservation refs and private bundles; build consumers and packaging pins. No state reset, import, routing change or host activation.

acceptance.text: Refresh local/hosted heads, worktrees and writers; preserve unique work; restore the reviewed tree from a separate bundle checkout.
Name every build/deployment consumer and prove it cannot upgrade to unsupported stubs; keep private evidence out of published refs.

tasks.title: Reconcile historical work and verify successor task routing
tasks.scope: Separate task-store prefixes and routes; historical open-task dispositions; inspected graph import. Source preservation remains a separate prerequisite for replacement. No state reset or deployment.

acceptance.text: Choose separate new prefix/store routes, verify local and foreign lookup, and reconcile historical open tasks with dispositions. Perform live routing only with its operational authority.
Inspect current stores by spec_id before import; preserve historical IDs and verify every imported node and blocking edge. Resolve ambiguous writes before retrying.

tasks.title: Replace the workspace with an executable foundation
tasks.scope: Target workspace crates, identity/value types, storage capabilities, toolchain, build/check entrypoints, fixture support and successor hooks/docs. Remove predecessor callers coherently.

acceptance.text: A fresh checkout builds packaged entrypoints and runs isolated checks; no supported route reaches todo! or an empty success stub.
Real model/blob tests pass; a deliberate forbidden crate edge and unauthorized writer access fail through actual compiler/runtime boundaries.
Replacement PR identifies removed capabilities and preserved files; successor hooks and commands work with their callers under required hosted checks. No usability or deployment claim.

Run packaged schema/catalog exports without live services, reject bad or unsupported configuration, and demonstrate isolated endpoint/state ownership with occupied-endpoint and partial-start failures. Runtime connection settings have one configuration channel.

Provide a test-only fault hook or observable boundary for the first path durability cases. The evaluator can interrupt a recorded owned process at that boundary; a timed sleep-and-kill cannot qualify crash recovery.

scope.polylogue: One Claude Code file through retained revision/parser/writer to search, read and export through CLI and MCP. Full slice 1 remains open.
scope.sinex: One Atuin source through retained material/observation/admission/search to CLI. Full slice 1 remains open; confirmed delivery and MCP require their own evidence.

acceptance.text: Packaged clients return independently specified Morrow or Kestrel facts from retained input via production storage and request paths.
Append, empty source and malformed input have explicit expected outcomes; restart/retry agrees with an uninterrupted run.
List supported commands/sources and remaining slice obligations. Sinex confirmed delivery and MCP stay open unless actually delivered and demonstrated.

tasks.title: Demonstrate the first path and its recovery independently
tasks.scope: Synthetic milestone demonstration script, independent expected facts and readable output from packaged clients. No private-corpus or deployed-service claim.

acceptance.text: One documented command repeats the demonstration from isolated state; expected and actual answers, candidate revision, executable identity and exact exit statuses are inspectable.
Expectations do not call the implementation; a deliberately wrong answer fails the comparison. Kill/restart exercises the relevant durability boundary.
Report failed-input handling and residual acceptance; retain raw logs in the owning run store. Operator usefulness and installed-client verification remain separate open criteria.
